hypotheses.justification: Split on 0 < ε. In the positive case, use the existing proof. Otherwise ε ≤ 0, and WeightedIncidence.mass_nonneg applied with hu gives nonnegative masses for P and Q. Thus ε / 2 * mass u P ≤ 0 ≤ mass u Q. This includes ε = 0 and empty α.

Split on 0 < R. In the positive case, use the existing proof. Otherwise mass_weight_mono w u hle P and hP give mass u P ≤ R ≤ 0. Since mass_nonneg u hu P gives the reverse bound, mass u P = 0. The conclusion then follows from mass_nonneg u hu Q. This covers R = 0 and empty α; negative R is incompatible with these bounds.
